sources.title: Should the Broncos trade up for Oregon TE Kenyon Sadiq?
sources.description: One prospect who may interest the Denver Broncos in the first round of the 2026 NFL Draft is Oregon tight end Kenyon Sadiq. He is a 6-3, 241-pound tight end who is expected to be a first-round pick, is viewed as the top tight end in the draft, and is one of the best playmakers […]
